On Monday, Ladybird developer Andreas Kling announced that the browser is launching in alpha on macOS and Linux following more than four years of development. The release makes Ladybird the first browser in years to arrive with an entirely new engine. We've seen many engines emerge over time, but the most popular browsers use just three today: Gecko, Blink, and WebKit. While Gecko, now used in Mozilla Firefox, first appeared in Netscape 6 in 2000 , Apple's WebKit arrived in Safari in 2003 as a fork of KDE's KHTML. However, after The New York Times reported there was evidence of another affair, this time with an Nvidia executive who reported directly to him, a board meeting that night ended with Huang’s resignation , and Nvidia CFO Colette Kress was installed as the new interim CEO. And then… Huang was back. In recent years, Nvidia has become a key part of the Trump administration’s AI push, a central figure in negotiations over potential Chinese access to cutting-edge AI hardware, and a company that has used its now $4 trillion-plus market cap to finance other AI companies. Saying it received input “from senior levels of the United States government,” Nvidia’s board announced his return as CEO on November 23rd, less than two weeks after his resignation.
